notes.title: Update 4: BODY ARMOR
notes.content:
That's right Body Armor is now in the game! As a rebalancing measure I added body armor to aid in the later levels. It's $2000 so it can be purchased right after completing the shop & go. You will loose the armor and have to re-buy if you die (same for all in game items). More Coming soon!

Whats New?
-Added body armor
-Improved police AI
-Minor bug fixes

If you run into any bugs please let me know either on the steam community page or on twitter (@NickRizzoGames)

notes.title: Update 3: More hotfixes and rebalancing!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I know a lot of you are patiently waiting for some extra content to be added. I can assure you new stuff will be added next week however I need to get rid of some bugs before we proceed with new content.

~~~~~~~~~~
Whats new?
~~~~~~~~~~
- Fixed navigation issue on the reserve
- Improved police car navigation
- [b] Pistols now come with more ammo! [/b] - Primarily to make it easier to get money at the start of the game.
- Graphical settings have been modified to allow for more users to easily run the game.
- Fixed navigation issue on airport, Thanks Dashie!
-Various smaller bug fixes

Another hotfix will be out within the next 2 days to address AI Behaviour issues

notes.title: Update 2: More hotfixes and some new stuff!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I've been reading your suggestions and bug reports and I am on it! I have more fixes and features on my list to add but I thought it would be a good idea to get this update out asap.

[b]What's new?[/b]
- Added more NPCs to some maps
- Slight police rebalancing
- AI improvements
- Fixed some performance issues for users on less powerful computers

Don't forget to follow me on twitter for development updates (@nickrizzogames), and if you run into any issues or have any suggestions leave them in the bugs/suggestions thread or message me on twitter. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Update 1: Day 1 hotfixes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for a successful launch! However as stated before there were some bugs that needed to be worked out and have been fixed!

Changes:
1. [b]Fixed key remapping glitch[/b], if you remap your keys and restart the game your jump key binding will no longer default to G. This was caused by an error reloading the key maps. If this issue still persists for you simply remap your jump key.
2. Fixed AI navigation
3. Fixed Cop Car Lighting issue
4. Fixed some hang ups caused by police spawns

If you run into any more bugs please report them so they can be fixed ASAP!

Development Updates follow me on twitter @NickRizzoGames
